dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the large posterior-lateral annulus, the mid-dorsal annulus, and the center of the anterior-lateral ring cluster form a wide scalene triangle across the visible torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated specular highlights along the dorsal midline and upper flank indicate a wet, highly reflective surface texture.
